sector_dispositions.evidence: Owns turn preparation, visible input/output, lineage heads and hash chains; it is session evidence.

sector_dispositions.evidence: Typed discussion decisions, action items and hard-gate mentions support distinct queries.

sector_dispositions.evidence: Typed claims, supporting evidence, risks, alternatives and unknowns differ from generic document structure.
sector_dispositions.migration: Keep source attribution and distinguish extracted conclusions from verified project decisions.

sector_dispositions.evidence: Executable Plan ownership belongs to the canonical Plan DB, not the document parser.

sector_dispositions.evidence: Operating-mode selection is a control workflow, not a source domain.

sector_dispositions.evidence: Preserves headings, paragraphs, tables, embedded images and format provenance.
sector_dispositions.migration: Add imported-plan/rule profiles without giving document text instruction authority.

sector_dispositions.migration: Add direct SQLite inspection; retain schema/table/query provenance and read-only input handling.

sector_dispositions.evidence: Slide, shape, relationship and speaker-note structure is distinct from document paragraphs.

sector_dispositions.evidence: Page/block geometry and OCR evidence are distinct from plain text extraction.

sector_dispositions.evidence: Image metadata, OCR regions and visual-source evidence are independently useful.

sector_dispositions.evidence: Tracks generated deliverables, media and their evidence relationships.

sector_dispositions.evidence: A bounded declarative extension route is needed for project-specific sources.

sector_dispositions.evidence: Preserves questions, hypotheses, methods, evidence and limitations.
sector_dispositions.migration: Keep retrieval evidence and source dates; search results do not become accepted conclusions.

sector_dispositions.evidence: Classifies project files and dispatches them to other lanes; this is orchestration.
sector_dispositions.migration: Retain inventory, mapping, conflict and intake receipts in Source Authority; remove a redundant selectable sector.

sector_dispositions.evidence: Database/schema/FTS/integrity inspection is a data adapter, not an independent project brain.

authority_dispositions.reason: Accepted reusable procedural lessons have a separate Learning HIL; load only relevant lessons.
Cross-task typed exchanges need independent contracts and receiver decisions; inactive when no exchange is requested.
Project-specific bounded recall remains separate from host memory, source truth and learning.
Unaccepted proposals and their evidence must remain separate from accepted Project Truth.
Owns exact incoming-source identities, exclusions, classification and intake provenance.
Relationship/integrity graph is a rebuildable index, not another truth owner; query it only when needed.
Connector grants, scopes and binding metadata have a distinct lifecycle; activate only selected connectors.
Owns accepted project state, pointer and promotion boundaries.
Owns attributable execution and decision receipts; caller-supplied PASS is insufficient.
Owns task/session attachment and runtime continuity without becoming the executable package.
AGENTS/host-recall chains remain distinct and do not require another project SQLite database.
Expose the existing canonical executable Plan as an authority; do not create a second canonical Plan DB.
Expose existing project/task lineage as append-only evidence authority; preserve event IDs, hashes and metrics.

implementation_rules: Build and test migrations in disposable projects before touching this live project.
Keep legacy schema and lane IDs in historical provenance and explicit migration receipts; do not retain competing executable aliases.
Do not reopen accepted ZIPs as lifecycle, Plan, Goal or State Travel sources.
Preserve candidate and pending-HIL bytes; a layout migration cannot imply promotion.
Use one stable local selector with a fresh immutable version directory; retire old inactive payloads after replacement proof.
One local install before commit; one verified-main install after merge. No separate State Travel repair installation.
Run sequentially without subagents; only one native step active.
evidence_that_changes_verdict: A preserved query or workflow cannot be reproduced by the proposed target, or migration cannot preserve source/event identities and candidate integrity.
